dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you have any recommended reads?

dialogues.speaker: Hunayn
dialogues.text: It depends on which Darshan and subject you're interested in.

dialogues.speaker: Hunayn
dialogues.text: I can give you a list based on that.

dialogues.speaker: Hunayn
dialogues.text: But only researchers and students at the Akademiya can borrow books from the House of Daena, so you will need a permit.
